metadata.source_review_scope: Adjudicate source-relevant GSK-3 transition-state phrase-scout near misses without within-threshold acceptor hits.

citation.title: Structural basis of GSK-3 inhibition by N-terminal phosphorylation and by the Wnt receptor LRP6.

reviewed_near_misses.source_basis: GSK-3/Axin AF3/Mg transition-state mimic with phosphorylated N-terminal autoinhibitory pS9 peptide; no heteromeric unmodified Ser/Thr/Tyr/SEP/TPO/PTR acceptor candidate was modeled near the kinase-associated AF3 group.
reviewed_near_misses.structure_title: Crystal structure of a transition state mimic of the GSK-3/Axin complex bound to phosphorylated N-terminal auto-inhibitory pS9 peptide

citation.title: Structural and functional effects of phosphopriming and scaffolding in the kinase GSK-3 beta.

reviewed_near_misses.source_basis: GSK-3/Axin AF3/Mg transition-state mimic with beta-catenin S45D peptide; the modeled substrate uses an Asp phosphomimetic at the named site, so no source-mapped hydroxyl acceptor is available for clean positive evidence.
reviewed_near_misses.structure_title: Crystal structure of a transition-state mimic of the GSK-3/Axin complex bound to a beta-catenin S45D peptide

evidence_against: 4NU1 and 8VMF have kinase-associated AF3/Mg transition-state analog context but do not model a clean source-mapped heteromeric hydroxyl acceptor near the analog.
4NU1 is an autoinhibitory phosphorylated-peptide context; 8VMF uses beta-catenin S45D phosphomimetic peptide. Neither is clean positive substrate-transfer evidence.
source_review_summary.recommendation: Keep GSK-3 transition-state phrase hits as review-only near-miss negatives unless a sibling structure models an unmodified source-mapped substrate acceptor near the kinase-associated analog.
